labels.rationale: No number of mice, no justification, no randomisation and no blinding, anywhere in the paper or the figure legends. Marked non-blocking because a replicator would use a conventional group size for a subcutaneous xenograft. Marked low confidence, and flagged for a different reason: the same paragraph asserts compliance with the ARRIVE guidelines, and this is ARRIVE item 3a. The paper supplies a claim that the field walk can test and then fails it. See AMB-136.

labels.anchor_text: tumor size and survival rate were monitored bi-daily
labels.rationale: No caliper, no imaging and no volume formula. The paper cannot avoid having used a formula, because the euthanasia trigger is stated as 300 mm3, which is a computed volume. The pack note on this field is exactly on point: L x W squared over 2 and L x W x H give materially different curves from the same animal. Note also that bi-daily has two opposite conventional readings, twice a day and once every two days, so even the sampling frequency is unrecoverable. See AMB-138.

labels.anchor_text: G418 or puromycin is used for selection
labels.rationale: Two defects in eight words. No concentration for either agent, and effective selection concentrations differ by more than tenfold between cell lines, so a wrong guess either kills the whole plate or selects nothing. And the agent itself is given as a disjunction: the reader cannot tell which of the two was used, or whether the choice differed between the three cell lines. The plasmid name carries both markers, T2A-Neo(puro), so the construct does not settle it either. See AMB-137.

labels.anchor_text: the membranes were washed six times with TBST
labels.rationale: The procedure jumps from RIPA lysis directly to washing membranes and then to secondary antibody. There is no protein quantitation, no load, no gel, no transfer, no blocking step, and no primary antibody incubation at all. The primary incubation is the central step of the assay and it is absent from the described procedure, which as written cannot produce the blots shown. The stated secondary conditions, 1:5000 at 4 C for 12 hours, are a primary antibody protocol. This reads as a paragraph that lost its middle. Distinct from a missing parameter: the described sequence is not executable. See AMB-134 and AMB-101.

labels.anchor_text: Trimming of 3ʹ adaptors and removal of low-quality
labels.rationale: Trimming and alignment tools are named and versioned, which is the easy half. Everything downstream is absent: no read counts, no replicate number, no quantification method, no differential expression tool, no fold-change threshold and no multiple testing correction. The Results then report exact gene counts, 2392 down and 396 up after METTL3 knockdown, 887 and 132 after METTL14, and the 1615 against 111 asymmetry that is the paper's headline claim. Those numbers are entirely determined by the thresholds, and no threshold is stated. Note the alignment target is UCSC HG19, superseded by GRCh38 well before 2024, which is a choice rather than a gap.

An m6A immunoprecipitated sample is named as one of two libraries, and no m6A IP protocol appears anywhere: no antibody, no fragmentation, no bead, no elution. Note also that no m6A-seq result is reported in the paper, only differential expression, so this is a method described for data that never appears. Medium confidence because the supplementary material was not available. See AMB-139.

labels.anchor_text: we performed co-immunoprecipitation using anti-METTL3 and anti-METTL14
labels.rationale: The mirror image of L15. Co-immunoprecipitation produces Figures 4E to 4J, which carry the paper's central proteomic claim, and it has no Methods section at all: no lysis condition, no antibody amount, no bead, no wash, no elution, no control IgG condition. It is described only in one Results sentence. A method that appears in the Results and not the Methods, and a method that appears in the Methods and not the Results, sit in the same paper. See AMB-139.

labels.anchor_text: phosphoproteomic study was conducted using a
labels.rationale: Two problems. The section describes a phosphopeptide workflow, and the experiment reported is co-immunoprecipitation of binding partners, not phosphoproteomics, so the stated assay and the reported result do not match. And the acquisition parameters are given in full while the entire identification half is absent: no search engine, no database, no enzyme, no modifications, no false discovery rate. Figure 4F reports iBAQ values, and no quantification method is described that could produce them.

No primary antibody dilution, no permeabilisation step, and no blocking agent concentration. Non-blocking: the secondaries carry catalogue numbers and dilutions, the fixation is stated, and primary dilution is conventionally optimised per lot. Note separately that the colocalization index M is reported as a number in Figures 4B and 4D with no thresholding method stated, which is the quantitative half of this assay.
